chunks: And it was narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"That is only disliked for fear that the one beside him may be harmed."

key_terms.جَانِبِهِ: His side; the person next to him
key_terms.يُؤْذَى: May be harmed or caused discomfort
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: It is considered disliked or makruh in legal context

ai.seo_question: Why is a certain act in prostration considered disliked according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that this act is considered makruh not because it is intrinsically invalid, but due to the possibility of causing harm or discomfort to another person nearby. The narration highlights that legal dislike in worship can be tied to consideration for the rights and well-being of others.
